lines.4: 「Guys, I found out. Looks like they baked cookies today in a joint class with Class B.」
lines.6: 「Well, they'd be just right for a three o'clock snack.」
lines.7: 「Even if they're only out of obligation, we still get homemade sweets. Can't beat that.」
lines.8: ...Crab might try to force-feed me some.
lines.9: No way. I'm not enough of a saint to eat something that nasty.
lines.10: I opened the classroom door and began my escape.
lines.11: I'd leave her to Subaru and Fukahire.
lines.12: ...All right. Evacuation complete, nice and early.
lines.13: Just as I relaxed, the student council office door clicked open.
lines.14: 「Tsushima, you're early to the student council office.」
lines.15: 「Good, it's you, Sato... I thought Crab had made it all the way here.」
lines.16: 「Perfect timing. We made cookies in class. Want some?」
lines.17: 「Sure. If you made them, Sato, I'm all for it.」
lines.19: When it was just Sato and me, even this room felt calm.
lines.22: Sato glanced up at me from under her lashes, checking my reaction.
lines.25: 「Between this and Valentine's Day, you really do take care of me.」
lines.26: Apparently she had gotten carried away making chocolate for the Princess and made too much, so she had given me a big heart-shaped one.
lines.30: Sato sat across from me, smiling as she watched me.
lines.31: 「You really know how to eat, Tsushima.」
lines.32: 「It's nice to watch from the cook's side, too. Maybe I'll make you something again sometime?」
lines.33: 「But all I do is eat it.」
lines.35: 「F-for you, Tsushima... I'd make as much as you want...」
lines.37: I got embarrassed too and looked away.
lines.39: I'd be flattering myself if I took this as proof she liked me.
lines.40: She probably just likes making other people happy.
lines.41: Still... even so, she was being awfully nice to me.
lines.42: 「Hm? What's this? Only two of you are here?」
lines.44: 「Oh, cookies. I happen to like cookies.」
lines.45: 「Ahaha. Help yourself if you like, Kurogane-senpai. I baked them.」
lines.46: 「I see. Homemade by Sato? That's a welcome treat. I'll have one.」
lines.48: 「The tea is excellent too. Sato, you'll make a fine wife.」
lines.50: I don't know why, but even as Sato blushed, she stole another glance at me.
